CLE won 2 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security. Effective FG% 47.5 to 46.8.
Biggest swing: Jaylen Brown personal foul (Donovan Mitchell draws the foul) (Q4 14.3), +22 points of CLE win probability.

Bench points: CLE 16, BOS 26. Points in the paint: 56–42. Second-chance points: 8–8.
